review:
Hot Chilli Bells 100 brings back BGaming's chilli-bell classic on 100 fixed lines. Expanding wilds help complete wins, scatters pay anywhere, and bonus symbols unlock a Hold and Win round with multipliers up to 15x.

Chance x2 lets you change pace by increasing the bonus odds for a slightly higher stake. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. The bonus arrives about once every 119 spins on average. It's a steady, good-value game with a familiar layout.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 119 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
